summary_note_en: Income events record dividends, distributions, withholding taxes, and where the cash went next. Keep this separate from trade history.

event_type_reference.distribution: Fund distribution or similar income event.
event_type_reference.interest_income: Cash interest received in broker or bank.

destination_reference.keep_as_cash: Income stays in a strategy cash bucket.
destination_reference.reinvest_same_symbol: Income reinvested into the same symbol.
destination_reference.reinvest_other_symbol: Income reinvested into a different symbol.
destination_reference.use_for_loan_payment: Income reserved to support debt service.
